Marissa — thanks for the draft. We will raise a PO for the pilot. A few clarifications: 

1) PO needs to reference the invoicing entity as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and include Redwood's EIN; can you confirm the exact remit name and address to put on the PO?
2) Regarding withholding: for certain APAC subsidiaries we will withhold 5% per local tax code Art. 12; we'll issue a withholding certificate once the first invoice is processed. Please confirm whether Redwood will accept a net amount invoiced (i.e., invoice gross, we remit net to you and provide certificate).
3) Billing currency — we prefer USD but need an explicit FX clause if invoices will be billed in local currency.

Also looping Oliver (legal counsel) who will upload a short set of redlines to the order form if needed.

Best,

Subject: RE: Starlight pilot — commercial questions (withholding & PO)

Marissa / team,

Reviewed procurement's asks and the attached redlines. High-level guidance: 

- PO remit details: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 230 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94105, EIN: 26-1234567" — confirm with Accounting for any entity nuances.
- Withholding: we should push for gross invoicing with Starlight providing withholding certificates. Our recommended clause: Redwood invoices gross; any withholding tax applied by Starlight will be documented by a tax certificate; Starlight may either (a) gross-up the payment or (b) provide documentation and accept Redwood's right to claim credit/refund in its tax filings. This preserves our revenue recognition while giving them a path to recovery.
- FX / currency: accept USD billing by default; add a short sentence that if Starlight requests local currency billing, Redwood will apply the FX rate on invoice date and document exchange in the invoice. Avoid open-ended FX adjustment exposure.

Operational asks for Lauren: if they remit net and provide certificates, will we be able to accept and how does that affect AR aging and collections? Also flag potential need for an escrow hold if they insist on net30 instead of our 60-day pilot term.

I'll prepare tracked redline language (Order Form Exhibit A, Section 4) and upload to Drive — expecting to share by EOD PST.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
